fee_notes: Royalty: greater of 6% of Gross Revenues or $1,500/month minimum. Marketing Fund Contribution: greater of 2% of Gross Revenues or $1,500/month minimum. Technology Fee: $2,000/month for first 5 users, $75 per additional user. Local Marketing required monthly spend varies by private office occupancy rate: below 25% = $6,000/mo; 25%-50% = $4,000/mo; 50%-75% = $2,500/mo; 75%-90% = $1,500/mo; at or above 90% = no minimum. Additional fees include: Transfer Fee (greater of $49,500 or then-current fee), Renewal Fee ($2,500), Training School Fee ($500), Technology Fee includes workplace management software/IT/CRM/Office 365, Procurement Fee (greater of 15% of gross value of materials/services or $25,000), Enterprise Internet ($1,000-$3,000/month), Member/Client Referral Fee (5%-30% of contracted value), Convention/Conference Fee ($600/year), Non-compliance Fee ($500 first violation, $250 thereafter).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty: The greater of (a) 6% of your Gross Revenues generated by your franchised business, or (b) $1,500/month (the "Monthly Minimum Royalty"). Currently payable monthly on the 10th business day of the following month.
Marketing Fund (or "Fund") Contribution: Currently the greater of: (a) 2% of your Gross Revenues; or (b) $1,500/month. Currently payable monthly on the 10th business day of the following month.
Local Marketing: If your private offices occupancy rate is: (A) below 25%, you must spend at least $6,000 per month; (B) between 25% and 50%, you must spend at least $4,000 per month; (C) between 50% and 75%, you must spend at least $2,500 per month; (D) between 75% and 90%, you must spend at least $1,500 per month; or (E) at or above 90%, there is no minimum required.
Technology Fee: $2,000 per month or then current fee, for the first five (5) users; $75 for each additional user. Currently payable monthly beginning on the 10th business day of the month following the month in which your Space is open.
